ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $P$ is a point on the line segment $AB$, and points $M$ and $N$ are the midpoints of line segments $AP$ and $PB$, respectively. If point $P$ is any point on the line segment $AB$, and $AB=12\, \text{cm}$, what is the length of the line segment $MN$ in $\text{cm}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since points M and N are the midpoints of the line segments AP and PB, respectively,\\
$\therefore AP=2MP$, $BP=2PN$.\\
$\therefore AP+BP=2MP+2PN=2MN$, that is $AB=2MN$.\\
$\because AB=12\ \text{cm}$,\\
$\therefore MN=\boxed{6}\ \text{cm}$.
